description: Output quality eval: verify ue-scaffold proposes architecture, uses ue_generate_code, and includes UE macro patterns

assertions.description: Should propose an architecture or class design
Should use ue_generate_code to scaffold the character class
Should include UE reflection macros in generated code
Should derive from an appropriate UE base class

assertions.criteria: Does the response give an evidence-backed scaffold receipt with architecture/class hierarchy, generated artifact paths and symbols, Unreal base type and reflection macros actually present or missing, validation, next integration steps, and an honest GENERATED/PARTIAL/FAILED status? In-memory or missing files and missing requested macros must not be called fully generated.
assertions.description: Should report the character scaffold result honestly (LLM judge)
Should propose appropriate UE class type for the inventory system
Should use ue_generate_code for class generation
Should include data container patterns (arrays, maps, or structs)
Should define core inventory operations

assertions.criteria: Does the response give an evidence-backed scaffold receipt with architecture/class hierarchy, generated artifact paths and symbols, Unreal base type and reflection macros actually present or missing, validation, next integration steps, and an honest GENERATED/PARTIAL/FAILED status? Hand-authored completion ideas must be distinguished from tool-generated inventory artifacts.
assertions.description: Should report the inventory scaffold result honestly (LLM judge)
Should identify this as a UMG widget task
Should use ue_generate_code for widget class scaffolding
Should include BindWidget pattern or reference common widget components
Should define health tracking properties and update logic

assertions.criteria: Does the response give an evidence-backed scaffold receipt with widget architecture/class hierarchy, generated artifact paths and symbols, UUserWidget and BindWidget/reflection patterns actually present or missing, validation, next integration steps, and an honest GENERATED/PARTIAL/FAILED status?
assertions.description: Should report the widget scaffold result honestly (LLM judge)

cases.prompt: Set up a GAS ability system

assertions.description: Should reference core GAS classes
Should use ue_generate_code with GAS features
Should include GAS-specific UE patterns and features
Should cover ASC initialization and ability granting

assertions.criteria: Does the response give an evidence-backed GAS scaffold receipt with architecture/class hierarchy, generated artifact paths and symbols, GAS base types and reflection patterns actually present or missing, validation, next integration steps, and an honest GENERATED/PARTIAL/FAILED status? Missing AbilitySystemComponent initialization must be called out rather than implied complete.
assertions.description: Should report the GAS scaffold result honestly (LLM judge)
